findings: Tone and breed now change the words (sentimental vs hilarious differ for every dog).
The gift follows one answer only: naps -> blanket, walk -> mug, car -> print, coffee -> mug (the prompt's Pick rule). Tone and every other answer never change it.
The toy, what the dog wears and the person are never sent; Juno's tennis ball appears nowhere.
The painting gets one generic sentence per tap (hs-artwork-profile.js), nothing specific to the dog.
